Test Steps: Verify adding a new employee with all valid mandatory fields
Test Data: 1. Log in as Admin 2. Navigate to HRMS > Employees 3. Click 'Add Employee' 4. Fill First Name, Last Name, Email, Password, Role, Branch 5. Click 'Save'
Type of Test cases: FirstName: John, LastName: Doe, Email: john@example.com, Role: Staff
Date of execution: New employee should be created successfully and appear in the employee list.

Test Steps: Verify validation when mandatory fields are left blank
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add Employee' 2. Leave 'Email' and 'First Name' blank 3. Click 'Save'
Date of execution: System should display validation errors for required fields and prevent form submission.

Test Steps: Verify validation for invalid email format
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add Employee' 2. Enter invalid email 3. Click 'Save'
Date of execution: System should reject the input and show an 'Invalid email format' error.

Test Steps: Verify validation when using an email that already exists in the system
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add Employee' 2. Enter an email that is already registered 3. Click 'Save'
Date of execution: System should show an error 'Email already exists' and prevent creation.

Test Steps: Verify adding an employee with all optional fields filled
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add Employee' 2. Fill all mandatory fields 3. Fill optional fields (DOB, Address, Designation, Department) 4. Click 'Save'
Date of execution: Employee should be created and all optional data should be saved accurately.

Test Steps: Verify First Name field accepts only valid characters (no special characters except hyphen/apostrophe)
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add Employee' 2. Enter numeric or special characters in First Name 3. Click Save
Date of execution: System should show validation error for invalid characters in Name.

Test Steps: Verify First Name length constraints (Min/Max length)
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add Employee' 2. Enter a single letter or a name exceeding 50 characters 3. Click Save
Date of execution: System should show validation error for exceeding length constraints.

Test Steps: Verify Phone Number field accepts exactly 10 digits (or valid format)
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add Employee' 2. Enter 9 digits or alphanumeric in phone 3. Click Save
Date of execution: System should show validation error for invalid phone number format.

Test Steps: Verify Password strength validation during employee creation
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add Employee' 2. Enter weak password (e.g., '123') 3. Click Save
Date of execution: System should prompt for a stronger password (if password policies are enabled).

Test Steps: Verify Date of Birth validation (Employee must be 18+)
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add Employee' 2. Enter DOB making employee under 18 years 3. Click Save
Date of execution: System should show validation error 'Employee must be at least 18 years old'.

Test Steps: Verify Date of Joining validation (Cannot be in far future)
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add Employee' 2. Enter DOJ 5 years in the future 3. Click Save
Date of execution: System should show validation error 'Invalid Date of Joining'.

Test Steps: Verify form reset functionality
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add Employee' 2. Fill fields 3. Click 'Cancel/Reset' 4. Open form again
Date of execution: Form should be completely cleared of previous inputs.

Test Steps: Verify that the employee list loads correctly with pagination
Test Data: 1. Navigate to HRMS > Employees 2. Scroll to bottom or check pagination controls
Date of execution: Table should display a set number of records (e.g.

Test Steps: Verify pagination 'Next' and 'Previous' buttons functionality
Test Data: 1. Navigate to HRMS > Employees 2. Click 'Next' 3. Click 'Previous'
Date of execution: List should correctly navigate between data pages without data duplication.

Test Steps: Verify sorting by Name (Ascending/Descending)
Test Data: 1. Navigate to HRMS > Employees 2. Click on 'Name' column header
Date of execution: Employee list should sort alphabetically in ascending/descending order.

Test Steps: Verify sorting by Department
Test Data: 1. Navigate to HRMS > Employees 2. Click on 'Department' column header
Date of execution: Employee list should group/sort by department name.

Test Steps: Verify search functionality with valid employee name
Test Data: 1. Enter a valid employee name in the search bar
Date of execution: The list should filter and display only the employee(s) matching the search term.

Test Steps: Verify search functionality with partial name match
Test Data: 1. Enter first 3 letters of an employee name in search bar
Date of execution: The list should display all employees whose names contain the substring.

Test Steps: Verify search functionality is case-insensitive
Test Data: 1. Enter name in lowercase when stored as uppercase
Date of execution: The list should display the employee regardless of case.

Test Steps: Verify search functionality with non-existent data
Test Data: 1. Enter a random string in the search bar
Date of execution: The list should display a 'No records found' message.

Test Steps: Verify filtering employees by Department
Test Data: 1. Select 'IT' from Department filter dropdown
Date of execution: The list should only show employees belonging to the IT department.

Test Steps: Verify filtering employees by Status (Active/Inactive)
Test Data: 1. Select 'Inactive' from Status filter dropdown
Date of execution: The list should only show deactivated/inactive employees.

Test Steps: Verify updating an employee's contact number
Test Data: 1. Click 'Edit' on an employee record 2. Update the phone number 3. Click 'Save'
Date of execution: The employee's phone number should be updated successfully.

Test Steps: Verify validation when updating email to an already existing email
Test Data: 1. Click 'Edit' on Employee A 2. Change email to Employee B's email 3. Click 'Save'
Date of execution: System should show an 'Email already exists' error and prevent update.

Test Steps: Verify validation when removing mandatory fields during update
Test Data: 1. Click 'Edit' on an employee 2. Clear the 'First Name' field 3. Click 'Save'
Date of execution: System should block the update and prompt that First Name is required.

Test Steps: Verify updating Employee Department and Designation
Test Data: 1. Click 'Edit' 2. Change Department and Designation 3. Click 'Save'
Date of execution: Employee profile should reflect the new department and designation.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can reset an employee's password
Test Data: 1. Click 'Edit' 2. Click 'Reset Password' 3. Enter new password 4. Save
Date of execution: Password should be updated and employee can login with the new password.

Test Steps: Verify updating Profile Picture with valid image format (JPG/PNG)
Test Data: 1. Click 'Upload Photo' 2. Select a 1MB JPG file 3. Save
Date of execution: Profile picture should be updated and displayed correctly.

Test Steps: Verify validation when uploading invalid file format for Profile Picture
Test Data: 1. Click 'Upload Photo' 2. Select a PDF or EXE file 3. Save
Date of execution: System should reject the file with 'Invalid file format' error.

Test Steps: Verify validation when uploading Profile Picture exceeding max size limit
Test Data: 1. Click 'Upload Photo' 2. Select a 15MB JPG file 3. Save
Date of execution: System should reject the file with 'File size exceeds limit' error.

Test Steps: Verify deactivating an active employee
Test Data: 1. Click 'Deactivate' or toggle status to inactive on an active employee
Date of execution: Employee status should change to Inactive.

Test Steps: Verify that a deactivated employee cannot log into the system
Test Data: 1. Deactivate an employee 2. Attempt to log in with their credentials
Date of execution: Login should fail with 'Account is inactive' error.

Test Steps: Verify reactivating an inactive employee
Test Data: 1. Find an inactive employee 2. Click 'Activate' or toggle status to active
Date of execution: Employee status should change to Active.

Test Steps: Verify reactivated employee can log in again
Test Data: 1. Reactivate employee 2. Attempt to log in with their credentials
Date of execution: Employee should successfully log in to their dashboard.

Test Steps: Verify assigning a specific role (Manager) during employee creation
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add Employee' 2. Select 'Manager' from the Role dropdown 3. Save
Date of execution: Employee should be created and inherit Manager-level permissions.

Test Steps: Verify changing role of an existing employee
Test Data: 1. Click 'Edit' 2. Change Role from 'Staff' to 'Admin' 3. Save
Date of execution: Employee should instantly gain/lose permissions based on the new role.

Test Steps: Verify validation if Role is not selected during creation
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add Employee' 2. Fill all details but leave Role empty 3. Save
Date of execution: System should show 'Role is required' validation error.

Test Steps: Verify that Non-Admin users cannot add or edit employees
Test Data: 1. Log in as a regular Staff member 2. Try to access HRMS > Employees URL directly
Date of execution: System should show 'Access Denied' or redirect to dashboard.

Test Steps: Verify API security against SQL Injection in Search Field
Test Data: 1. Go to Employees list 2. Enter SQL injection payload in search bar
Date of execution: System should sanitize input and show 'No records found' safely.

Test Steps: Verify XSS vulnerability in Add Employee form
Test Data: 1. Add Employee 2. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> in First Name 3. Save
Date of execution: System should sanitize input and save it as plain text preventing script execution.
